panel_section: section of the panel (TOP, BOTTOM, or WHOLE)
panel_abuts_inline_stile_front: indicates whether the panel's front edge abuts a stile
panel_abuts_inline_stile_back: indicates whether the panel's back edge abuts a stile
component_height: height of the component in inches
component_width: width of the component in inches
component_floor_clearance: floor clearance of the component in inches
component_ceiling_clearance: ceiling clearance of the component in inches
panel_front_inline_stile_floor_to_ceilin: indicates whether the front stile is floor to ceiling
panel_back_inline_stile_floor_to_ceiling: indicates whether the back stile is floor to ceiling
stile_in_the_back_width: width of the stile in the back in inches
cutout: cutout specification (e.g. B-386 or B-354 & B-386)
